h: Ten Shabbosos Prepare the Heart for Repentance and Redemption

p: Now, in the ten Shabbosos from parshas Pinchas,
that is, from the seventeenth of Tammuz
we read as haftarah the three of retribution
as explained in the Shulchan Aruch,
and the division into three and seven
corresponding to the seven lower ones,
which correspond to the seven days of building,
שֶׁהֵם הַנִּסְתָּרוֹת לַה׳ אֱלֹהֵינוּ (דְּבָרִים כט, כח)
which are "the hidden things belonging to Hashem our God" (Devarim 29:28).
And corresponding to them are the three of retribution,
that is, to rectify what they blemished then
and the beginning of the three haftaros
and they correspond to speech, hearing, and sight.
And this is because the attribute of Malchus
is called speech, the word of Hashem;
which corresponds to the attribute of Malchus,
אִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק א לב, א)
is stated in the holy Zohar (I 32a):
וְכֵן אִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (חֵלֶק ג רא, ב)
and so it is stated in the holy Zohar (III 201b):
דְּמְמַנָּא עַל כָּל שְׁאָר פּוּמִין וְכוּלֵּי
that is appointed over all other mouths, etc.,
that which is called 'the mouth of Hashem,' etc."
וְכֵן מָצִינוּ בְּהַפְטוֹרָה דְּשַׁבָּת זֶה (יִרְמְיָה א, ט)
And so we find in the haftarah of this Shabbos (Yirmiyahu 1:9):
"Behold, I have put My words in your mouth";
כֵּן יִהְיֶה דְבָרִי אֲשֶׁר יֵצֵא מִפִּי
"So shall My word be that goes out of My mouth:
it shall not return to Me empty,
although in his time it was not heeded,
for not listening to his voice,
and through this the retributions came
but in the Gemara (Berachos 6b) it is stated:
כָּל מִי שֶׁיֵּשׁ בּוֹ יִרְאַת שָׁמַיִם
that whoever has fear of Heaven
becomes a chariot for the attribute of Malchus,
which is the aspect of fear,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זֹהַר חֵלֶק א ה, ב)
"for she is fear, and fear dwells in her";
which we call Torah she'b'al peh,"
and it is "My words which I have put in your mouth";
and then "it shall not return to Me empty,"
And therefore the Gemara there brings
"The end of the matter, all having been heard, etc.";
that is, although in his time it was not heeded,
it will come about and turn out
"A prophecy needed for the generations was written,"
and a time will come when it will be heeded.
And for this we read the haftarah
לְתַקֵּן מַה שֶּׁלֹּא שָׁמְעוּ אָז דְּבָרָיו
to rectify that they did not heed his words then,
and that they be heeded today;
and it corresponds to the attribute of Keser Elyon,
which is the crown of kingship.
hearing, corresponds to the attribute of Chochmah.
corresponds to the attribute of Binah, the heart:
that is, that it enter the depths of the heart,
וְעַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (קֹהֶלֶת א, טז)
along the lines of what is said (Koheles 1:16):
And afterward the seven of consolation
correspond to the seven lower attributes;
and they are all preparation for Rosh Hashanah,
for "in Tishrei they will be redeemed,"
and he follows his own view,
"If Yisrael do teshuvah, they are redeemed."
who holds that in Nissan they will be redeemed,
for he holds, "'And not with money':
not with teshuvah and good deeds."
וּמַר אָמַר חֲדָא וּמַר אָמַר חֲדָא
And one Master said one thing and the other Master said another,
for "these and those are the words of the living God":
דְּאִם חַס וְשָׁלוֹם לֹא יַעֲשׂוּ תְשׁוּבָה
if, Heaven forbid, they do not do teshuvah,
אָז לֹא יַנִּיחֵם גַּם כֵּן הַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
Hashem Yisbarach will still not abandon them,
and they will be redeemed in Nissan,
in His kindness, for the sake of His Name;
then they will be redeemed in Tishrei.
And for this comes the preparation for it
וְאַף אִם הַבֵּירוּר הוּא מִצַּד הָאָדָם
And although, if the refinement is from the side of man,
it must be from below to above,
from the attribute of Malchus upward,
"Return us, Hashem, to You, and we shall return"
(as is written in Midrash Rabbah, end of Eichah);
וְהַיְינוּ עַל פִּי מַה שֶּׁנֶּאֱמַר (שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים א, ד)
and this is according to what is said (Shir HaShirim 1:4):
"Draw me, we will run after You";
for although in truth "we will run,"
"Our will is to do Your will,
The leaven in the dough, etc.";
yet we ask, "Draw me after You,"
so that the one standing behind us not pull us
And from the side of Hashem Yisbarach,
the refinement is from above to below;
corresponds to the attribute of Keser.
וּמְסַיֵּים הַפְטוֹרָה זוֹ בְּפָסוּק (יִרְמְיָה ב, ג)
And this haftarah concludes with the pasuk (Yirmiyahu 2:3):
"Yisrael is holy to Hashem, the first of His crop";
that is, Yisrael are bound at the root
which is the aspect of Keser Elyon,
which is the crown of kingship;
שֶׁזֶּה הָיָה תַּכְלִית מַעֲשֵׂה שָׁמַיִם וָאָרֶץ
for this was the purpose of the making of heaven and earth,
that Yisrael accept the yoke of His kingship,
וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה הֵם מַכְתִּירִים לְהַשֵּׁם יִתְבָּרַךְ
and thereby they crown Hashem Yisbarach
And so it was said to Yirmiyahu (Yirmiyahu 1:5):
"Before I formed you in the belly I knew you,
and before you came out of the womb I sanctified you, etc.";
and this too is in the beginning of thought.
"I remember for you the kindness of your youth,
the love of your bridal days";
Yisrael were called by the title "bride,"
שֶׁעַל זֶה נִתְיַיסֵּד כָּל שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים
on which the whole of Shir HaShirim is founded,
the yoke of His kingship, may His Name be blessed,
casts aside all his affairs for the sake of His Name.
"your going after Me in the wilderness,"
that they did not take to heart,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ (מִדְרַשׁ רַבָּה שִׁיר הַשִּׁירִים א, יג)
how many pregnant women there are among them, etc.;
how many kinds of soft foods
have you prepared for the pregnant women among them? etc.";
that they go into the wilderness,
מִן הַסְּתָם לֹא יֶחְסַר לָהֶם כְּלוּם
for the nations do not understand
how a person can rest a seventh of the year,
and for the day of resting
אִם כֵּן לֹא יַעֲשׂוּ מְלָאכָה בְּשַׁבָּת
"If so, let them not do work on Shabbos,
that on the contrary, from Shabbos
וְהוּא רַק עַל יְדֵי שְׁלֵימוּת הָאֱמוּנָה
and this is only through complete faith,
"Borrow on My account and sanctify the holiness of the day,
and trust in Me, and I will repay."
relinquish the matters of This World,
and "it is a day of souls
and not a day of the body"
and one casts aside all his affairs,
as is written in the Mechilta (on Shemos 20:9):
"'And you shall do all your work':
that it should be as though all your work were done";
and this is called "your going after Me in the wilderness."
לָכֵן יָכוֹל כָּל אָדָם לִזְכּוֹת בְּשַׁבָּת
Therefore every person can merit on Shabbos
to be bound at the root,
And for this, the main preparation for Rosh Hashanah
for on Shabbos it is easy
to become refined in all the attributes
and then, "in Tishrei they will be redeemed."
